A man managed to trap two cyclopes in the cellar of the Thais lighthouse and forced them to forge weapons. With the help of a partner, you activate a pressure plate and a lever to open the teleport to the secret room and open the chests with the {item:Dark Shield} and the {item:Battle Hammer}.
A man managed to trap two cyclopes in the lighthouse cellar and forced them to make weapons.
Agree beforehand with your partner who stays on the pressure plate and who goes down to pull the lever.
The lighthouse is in **Thais**, **southwest** of the depot, by the coast. Enter the lighthouse and go down to the cellar. On the way you may run into {creature:Wolf|Wolves}.
You enter a square room with a corpse. The corpse has a {item:Imprisoned Cyclops (Book)|book} that tells of a secret dungeon.
Look for a hidden {item:Lever|lever} under some {item:Crate|crates}. Move the crates aside and pull the lever: a stair appears going down. Go down.
Down there are three passages: **north**, **south** and **east** (right).
One of the players goes through the **north** passage and stands on the pressure plate. As long as someone is there, stairs appear at the **south** end.
Player 1 has to stay on the plate until the other one pulls the lever.
The other player goes to the **south** end, goes down the stairs that appeared and pulls the lever. This makes the teleport to the quest room appear in the **east** passage.
Both of you go to the **east** (right) passage and step into the teleport.
There are only 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} in the room. You can kill them or ignore them.
Go to the **north** end of the room and open the {item:Chest (Quest)|chests} with the {item:Dark Shield} and the {item:Battle Hammer}.
Leave and go back to Thais

The wiki doesn't describe a dedicated exit from the cyclops room: go back the same way to the lighthouse cellar (the stairs you used to go down) and climb up to the ground floor. You come out in the lighthouse, inside Thais, southwest of the depot.
